name: Kimpton Aysla Mallorca
insider_take: This boutique gem sits in the heart of Mallorca's vibrant capital, where centuries-old Gothic architecture meets modern Mediterranean flair in one of the Balearic Islands' most culturally rich destinations.
whats_special: Kimpton Aysla Mallorca occupies a beautifully restored historic building in Palma's old town, just steps from the magnificent La Seu Cathedral - one of Europe's finest examples of Gothic architecture. The hotel seamlessly blends Mallorcan heritage with Kimpton's signature contemporary design, featuring local artisan crafts and traditional island materials throughout its interiors.
pro_tip: Book a room facing the cathedral for breathtaking views, especially during the twice-yearly light phenomenon when the morning sun creates a spectacular kaleidoscope effect through the rose window onto the opposite wall.
dont_miss: Explore the nearby Barrio Gótico's winding cobblestone streets, visit the vibrant Mercat de l'Olivar for fresh local produce, and take the historic wooden train to the charming mountain village of Sóller - a journey through dramatic Serra de Tramuntana landscapes that inspired countless artists and poets.
pros: Adults-only luxury retreat with sophisticated ambiance
Stunning Mediterranean views and prime Mallorca location
Kimpton's signature personalized service and boutique hospitality
Modern wellness facilities and spa amenities
cons: Adults-only policy excludes families with children
